balance.title: Your balance
balance.body: This is your live balance. Income adds to it, expenses subtract from it. You can also correct it by hand with the pencil.

actions.title: Record money moving
actions.body: Add income or an expense here. Every entry updates the balance and shows up in your statistics.

essentials.title: Your monthly bills
essentials.body: Tick a bill once you have paid it. Only unticked bills count as money you still owe, and every figure named “after essentials” is based on them.

nextMonth.title: Planning ahead
nextMonth.body: Enter what you expect to earn next month, subtract the bills you already know about, and set the share you want to save.

statistics.title: See the whole picture
statistics.body: Statistics breaks any month down by category, by day and against previous months.

hints.daysLeft: Days remaining until the end of the current month.
hints.dailyBudget: Your balance divided by the days left in the month.
hints.remainingAfterEssentials: Your balance minus the bills you have not ticked off yet.
hints.dailySpendingAvailable: What is left after unpaid bills, divided by the days remaining.
hints.totalMoneyIncome: What you expect to earn next month.
hints.nextRemainingAfterEssentials: Next month expected income minus the bills you have already listed for it.
hints.saveMoney: The share of next month remainder you have chosen to put aside.
hints.saveMoneyAfterPercent: What you can spend next month once your savings are set aside.
